verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a GPU machine catalog that includes the current-generation NVIDIA H100, gated behind an approval request, alongside older options such as Ampere A100s. A community report also shows a Quadro P6000 in use, so a range from current to cheaper previous-generation GPUs exists. Missing for 10: any evidence of H200 or B200 availability, a documented full GPU list with tiered pricing, and evidence that H100 access isn't constrained by the approval gate.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can choose from current-generation datacenter GPUs (H100/H200/B200 class) as well as cheaper previous-generation options

citations.quote: If you choose any high-end machines, such as NVIDIA H100, you need to request for approval to use them.
Build & Run AI/ML Models on NVIDIA H100 GPUs
